bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wM has one canonical Ethereum wrapper deployment; Arbitrum, Base, Plume, and Solana are bridge representations reached through M0 issuer-native burn/mint routes. Current Arbitrum and Base SpokePortal admins/operators, route paths, pause state, and upgrade implementations are structured below; Plume uses an owner-controlled Hyperlane Portal/Bridge with a separate pauser; Solana Portal message validation, Portal upgrade authority, and m_ext ProgramData upgrade authority are route-scoped separately from the local M-backed wrapper mint recorded in Mint Authority. The route tier remains issuer-native-lock-mint.
